definitions.explanation: Resistant to outside influence, newcomers, or new ideas; characterized by exclusivity and lack of openness.

examples.japanese: この{村|むら}は{閉鎖的|へいさてき}で{外部|がいぶ}の{人|ひと}を{受|う}け{入|い}れない。
examples.english: This village is insular and doesn't accept outsiders.

examples.japanese: {閉鎖的|へいさてき}な{組織|そしき}は{変化|へんか}に{弱|よわ}い。
examples.english: Closed organizations are weak against change.

examples.japanese: {閉鎖的|へいさてき}な{考|かんが}え{方|かた}を{改|あらた}める{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to change our insular way of thinking.

notes:
FORMS:
・{閉鎖的|へいさてき}な + noun (adnominal)
・{閉鎖的|へいさてき}に (adverbial)
・{閉鎖的|へいさてき}だ (predicative)

FORMATION:
{閉鎖|へいさ} (closure) + {的|てき} (-like, -ic)

USAGE:
Commonly describes:
・{組織|そしき} (organizations)
・{社会|しゃかい} (societies)
・{地域|ちいき} (communities)
・{考|かんが}え{方|かた} (mindsets)

ANTONYM:
・{開放的|かいほうてき} (open, receptive)

RELATED TERMS:
・{排他的|はいたてき} - exclusive, exclusionary
・{保守的|ほしゅてき} - conservative
